reference.divisionMethods: PyJHora named chart functions; D2 chart_method=2, other named charts chart_method=1, unnamed divisions use PyJHora custom cyclic mapping.
reference.numericToleranceRationale: Four double-precision ULPs at the 0-360 degree scale accommodate only serialization and operation-order rounding; shared-core output is not independent ephemeris evidence.
reference.sharedCoreCaveat: PyJHora uses Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03; LIFE uses @swisseph/node 1.4.0 and the same local data, but its embedded Swiss version is not exposed. Shared implementation family means this is a pipeline/convention cross-check, not independent ephemeris validation.
